leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.message: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be lost.

editor.lead: Totals are calculated by the server while you type. Nothing is issued until you confirm it.
editor.loadError: The draft could not be loaded.
editor.issuedReadOnly: This document is issued and cannot be edited any more.
editor.correctionNote: This correction starts as a copy of the effective document. Change the lines so that they make up the complete corrected document. When it is issued, its number is the number of the invoice with a suffix.
editor.serviceDateToHint: Only for a service period. Leave empty for a single day.
editor.adhoc: Ad hoc line, no catalogue item
editor.vatRateFixed: Fixed at 0 under the Kleinunternehmer regime.
editor.previewIncomplete: Complete the lines to see the totals.
editor.previewInvalid: The server cannot calculate these lines. Check the marked fields.
editor.previewFailed: The totals could not be calculated.
editor.saveError: The draft was not saved. Check the marked fields.
editor.issueHint: The draft is saved before the confirmation opens.

list.title: Documents
list.loadError: The documents could not be loaded.
list.emptyDescription: No document matches the filter. Create an invoice or an offer to start.

totals.title: Totals
totals.kleinunternehmer: Kleinunternehmer regime: no VAT is charged.

detail.title: Document
detail.lead: Read only. An issued document is never changed.
detail.loadError: The document could not be loaded.
detail.draftNote: This is a draft. It has no number yet and can still be changed.
detail.supersededNote: A newer correction replaced this document. It stays as it was issued.
detail.correctHint: Starts a correction draft with the lines of the effective document.
detail.correctOwnerOnly: Only the owner corrects an invoice.
detail.pdfNote: The PDF download is not available yet. It follows with the PDF renderer.

discard.title: Discard this draft?
discard.message: The draft is deleted. This cannot be undone.
discard.conflict: The document was issued in the meantime and cannot be deleted.
discard.error: The draft could not be discarded.

issue.confirmMessage: Issuing assigns the number and freezes the document. An issued document can never be changed or deleted again. A mistake is fixed with a correction.
issue.changedDuringSave: The draft changed while it was being saved. Save it again, then issue.

blocked.saving: Issuing waits until the draft is saved.
blocked.calculating: Issuing waits until the totals are calculated.
blocked.incomplete: Complete the lines first. Issuing needs calculated totals.
blocked.invalid: The server cannot calculate these lines. Fix the marked fields to issue.
blocked.failed: The totals could not be calculated. Calculate again to issue.

issue.discardMessage: This draft is based on a document that was corrected in the meantime. It is deleted and cannot be restored.
issue.discardError: The draft could not be discarded.
issue.newCorrection: Start a new correction from the effective document

errors.renderer: Issuing is not available yet. The PDF renderer that checks a document before it is frozen is not set up. Your draft is saved. Try again later.
errors.rendererCorrection: Correcting is not available yet. A document can only be corrected once the PDF renderer is set up.
errors.regimeMismatch: The VAT regime of the draft differs from the regime that applies today ({regime}). Change the VAT regime of the draft and issue again.
errors.regimeMissing: No VAT regime period covers today. Add one in the settings first.
errors.baseChanged: A newer correction became effective in the meantime (correction {seq}). This draft stays as it is. Start a new correction from the effective document.
errors.regimeChanged: This correction would need the VAT regime of the original invoice, but another regime applies today. A correction across a change of regime is not supported yet.
errors.conflict: The document was issued already, or its number exists already. Reload the page.
errors.draftChanged: The draft changed in the meantime. Reload the page and check it.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.fields: The document is incomplete. Check the listed fields.
errors.transport: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection.
errors.server: The server had an error. Try again later.
errors.other: That did not work. Try again.

reasons.badPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, for example 7,5.
reasons.badAmount: Enter an amount such as 95 or 95,50.
reasons.badQuantity: Enter a quantity above 0 with at most three decimals, for example 2,5.
reasons.badRate: Enter a VAT rate from 0 to 100, for example 19.
reasons.offerNoPeriod: An offer has no service period.
reasons.periodFromRequired: Enter the start of the service period first.
reasons.periodOrder: The end must not be before the start.
reasons.validUntilOffer: Only an offer has a validity date.
reasons.discountExclusive: Use a percentage or an amount, not both.
reasons.rateRange: The value must be between 0 and 100.
reasons.negative: The value must not be negative.
reasons.kleinunternehmerRate: Under the Kleinunternehmer regime the VAT rate is 0.
reasons.exemptLine: A line without VAT needs an exemption reason under the standard regime. That is not supported yet.
reasons.noCatalogueItem: This catalogue item does not exist.
reasons.invalidRegime: Choose the standard regime or the Kleinunternehmer regime.
reasons.wrongType: The value has the wrong type.
reasons.taxNumberRequired: A tax number or VAT ID is required in the seller profile.
reasons.servicePeriodRequired: An invoice needs a service date.
reasons.regimeUnknown: No VAT regime applies today. Choose one.
reasons.typeFixed: The type of a draft never changes.
reasons.typeInvalid: The document type is not valid.
reasons.sellerIdRequired: The seller profile needs a tax number, a VAT ID or a Kleinunternehmer ID. Add one in the settings.
reasons.unknownRegime: The default VAT regime of the seller profile is not known. Choose one in the settings.
reasons.taxNoteRequired: A tax note is required when a line is tax exempt.
reasons.invalidUtf8: The text contains an invalid character.
reasons.numbering: The number could not be formed. Check the number formats in the seller profile.
reasons.tooManyChars: The text is too long to print.
reasons.bidiChar: The text contains a bidirectional control character. It is not allowed.
reasons.controlChar: The text contains a control character. It is not allowed.
reasons.unprintableChar: The text contains a character that cannot be printed: {char} ({code}).
reasons.tooLarge: The document is too large to print. Shorten the texts or remove lines.
reasons.countryCode: Enter an assigned two letter country code such as DE.
reasons.oneOf: The value is not one of the allowed values.
reasons.figuresMismatch: The figures do not match the calculation. Save the draft again and issue once more.
reasons.sellerInvalid: This part of the seller profile is missing or cannot be printed. Fix it in the settings.
reasons.customerInvalid: This part of the customer data is missing or cannot be printed. Fix it under Customers.

payments.title: Payments
payments.loadError: The payments could not be loaded.
payments.refundDueNote: More was paid than the invoice asks for. A refund of {amount} is due.
payments.paidInFull: The invoice is paid in full.
payments.reverseMessage: Use this for a recording mistake. A counter entry with the opposite amount and the same date is added. The entry itself is never deleted or changed.
payments.reverseError: The entry could not be reversed.
payments.recordHint: Enter the day the money arrived and the amount.
payments.refundHint: Money paid back to the customer. At most {max} is due.
payments.saveError: The entry was not saved. Check the marked fields.
payments.conflict: The payments changed in the meantime. The list was reloaded, check it and try again.

fields.receivedOnHint: Date as 2026-12-03. It must not be in the future.
fields.amountRefundHint: Amount paid back, without a sign. At most {max}.

reasons.dateRange: The date must be between 2000-01-01 and today.
reasons.badAmount: Enter an amount above 0, for example 95 or 95,50.
reasons.noteChars: The note must not contain control characters.
reasons.noRefundDue: No refund is due. Undo a recording mistake with Reverse.
reasons.refundAboveDue: A refund may pay back at most the refund due.
reasons.refundAboveDueAmount: A refund may pay back at most {max}.
reasons.reversalAmount: A reversal carries the opposite amount of the entry it undoes.
reasons.reversalDate: A reversal carries the date of the entry it undoes.
